# BloodHound CE sample data

`ad_sampledata.zip` is SpecterOps' public Active Directory sample collection for BloodHound Community Edition: three fictional lab domains (phantom.corp, ghost.corp, wraith.corp) collected with SharpHound, file format version 6.

- Source: https://bloodhound.specterops.io/get-started/quickstart/ce-ingest-sample-data
- Downloaded on 26 October 2026 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SpecterOps/BloodHound-Docs/main/docs/assets/sample-data/ad_sampledata.zip
- Licence: Apache License 2.0, copied unchanged in `LICENSE` from the SpecterOps/BloodHound-Docs repository.

It is synthetic lab data with no activity over time and no alerts. We use it only to test that our importer reads a real SharpHound collection.
